clauses: This prominent molecular biologist and chemist made enduring contributions to the field of biochemistry.
As a dedicated university teacher and researcher, his groundbreaking work earned him widespread international recognition.
His numerous accolades include the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, the Copley Medal, the Albert Lasker Award for Basic Medical Research, and the Canada Gairdner International Award.
Despite his monumental legacy in the life sciences, he did not attend the University of Chicago.
